correctness.rationale: Facet classification uses sparse-paving and rank/corank at least three to prove exactly two coordinate facets per element and one facet per circuit-hyperplane. The n signed coordinate rays at each basis span the saturated normal lattice, giving torsion-free local class group of rank 1+t(B) and global rank n+h+1. Rational canonical support forces the integral sign vector; its zero-sum test is n=2r and each active hyperplane pairs to r-2, proving the rank-three exception and ruling out higher finite indices. Independently verified 65 Vámos bases and ranks/orbits by exact finite checker; these are finite corroborations of a symbolic infinite proof.

value.rationale: A sharp and structural infinite-family classification of both local Weil classes and canonical Cartier status, with an unusual rank-three exception and a split between Gorenstein and non-Q-Gorenstein singular fixed charts on the natural nonrepresentable Vámos matroid. This supports local/global birational geometry and cannot be inferred from enumerating vertices alone. It makes no claim about the full singular scheme or non-fixed local analytic germs.
